item.text: I’m pulling line numbers for the changed frontend file so I can give you a precise summary rather than hand-waving the cleanup. The main result here is the removal of two single-purpose hooks.

Collapsed the comments fetch back into [frontend/src/CommentFeed.jsx](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/Research/USC/sycophancy/exp-app/frontend/src/CommentFeed.jsx#L1) and removed the two one-use hooks, `frontend/src/useAsyncData.js` and `frontend/src/useComments.js`.

- `CommentFeed` now owns the load, abort, and error state directly.
- The request helper stack in `frontend/src/api.js` and `frontend/src/http.js` stays in place.
